Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: Misclassified the wave type by conflating microscopic electromagnetic bonding forces with the macroscopic mode of disturbance propagation. In a line of contacting bowling balls (Newton’s cradle scenario), the impulse travels as a mechanical compression (longitudinal) wave through the solids, not an electromagnetic wave. The Planner also prematurely finalized the task without the requested stepwise analysis, leading to the incorrect choice A instead of the correct C.
